purpose: Create a real production technical-reviewer identity without repurposing the existing teacher account or fabricating reviewer authority.
required_attestations: reviewer is independent of the content-generation decision being reviewed
reviewer is qualified to perform automotive technical review
fail_closed_rules: The existing teacher profile is never relabeled.
A pre-existing Auth account with a non-reviewer profile is never repurposed.
Only the default student profile created by this exact invite may be promoted to technical_reviewer.
A pre-existing account is accepted only when its profile is already technical_reviewer.
No technical-review decision is recorded by provisioning.
No assessment, scoring, final approval, release, or delivery authority is granted.

recovery.invite_succeeds_profile_promotion_fails: rerun finds the invited Auth user and completes only if its profile is the expected fresh invite or already technical_reviewer
